summary: Yiren Digital filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited second quarter 2026 results, a routine earnings report rather than a special situation. The company reported loans facilitated of RMB6.3 billion, down 29% sequentially, repeat borrowers at 82% of volume, and improved 31-60 and 61-90 day delinquency rates of 2.0% and 2.4%. On July 2, 2026 the board authorized a new US$20.0 million share repurchase program over 12 months, a modest capital-return authorization embedded in results. No deal terms, advisors, or structural mechanics are stated; watch buyback execution pace and continued loan-volume contraction.
